name: overnight: reboots, mixed use with music and hypervisor-path stress, forced suspend cycles, memory test, latency, EL2 torture by exit class (two rounds), screen-off standby (about 10 hours; start after 21:00)

el2_monitor.note: EL2 parallel log: monitor modules loaded and started on every boot, /proc/xcore_stats sampled every second on the device. artifacts = a directory with the monitor's .ko set (environment variable XHYPER_MONITOR_ARTIFACTS); remove this key or pass --no-el2 to run without the monitor

phases.packages_note: Runs start after 21:00 (nobody in the office), so sound is fine; the tablet is a test unit, so random deletes on shared storage are fine (the harness lives in /data/local/tmp/stab, out of reach). Still no clock or calendar: alarms and reminders set by random taps stay on the device and would wake later runs' suspend phases; no settings or browser.

music.note: host/make-music.py generates the track; STAB_MUSIC_LOCAL = its path on the host, pushed again if random taps deleted the device copy

phases.note: one exit class per step (device/el2stress.sh; radio and copy borrowed from kylin100-autotest), two rounds; late in the night: a hang here can only cost the standby phase
